title: Chapter 482 Night Attack
content:
Chapter 482 Night Attack

Ayub also flew up to the sky and took a closer look with a stern look on his face.

The number of people on the opposite side has exceeded ten million.

It’s similar to Wang Shuo’s side.

Wang Shuo returned to the camp and found Gu Liji.

"Go and investigate immediately to see how the Parthian Empire has so many troops."

"Yes, Your Majesty."

Not long after, Guliji came back and reported: "Your Majesty, the Batanddia Empire has taken action."

Wang Shuo frowned: "How many people did they send?"

"The spies have not found out the specific number of people, but there are at least 10 of the strongest kings."

Wang Shuo was shocked. It seemed that this time it was going to be a tough battle.

Subsequently, Wang Shuo, Zhao Bond, Ayub and others held an emergency meeting and formulated a combat strategy.

There are a total of 30 strongest kings in the Vana Empire army. Wang Shuo believes that no force can stop this power.

Even if it's a tough battle, it doesn't matter. As long as he can kill the king of the Batanddia Empire, it's worth it even if he suffers losses on his side.

This night.

The moonlight was hazy, and at the third watch, there was silence all around the military camp.

Except for the soldiers on night duty, everyone else had gone to bed.

Suddenly, a squad of 100 people took advantage of the situation and entered Wang Shuo's tent.

Among these 1000 people, there are 20 strongest kings, and the rest are all high-level generals.

This time, they wanted to sneak attack on the top officials of the Vana Empire.

It is best to kill Wang Shuo or General Ayub.

This way, this battle will be easy.

The army of the Parthian Empire has also been prepared and can attack as soon as the signal is sent.

The leader of the team this time was one of the strongest kings of the Batanddia Empire, named Li Yijun, who was a king who was proficient in assassination.

Since they don't know much about the distribution of the Wana Empire's camp, they can only determine the target for assassination based on the strength of the target's aura.

Li Yijun was really unlucky. The first target he found was Gong Zheng.

"who?"

Before the Liuye dagger could hit Gong Zheng, Gong Zheng opened his eyes.

"There are assassins."

Gong Zheng shouted.

In fact, the defense of the camp was pretty good.

However, the people dispatched on the opposite side were all masters, and ordinary soldiers did not notice it. This was also very helpless.

At the same time, assassins took action in other places.

There was chaos in the camp.

Wang Shuo's tent also had an assassin.

Wang Shuo immediately summoned the three pets.

He was also a little confused about the situation, because there were shouts of killing outside one after another.

Summon the three king pets to maximize your combat effectiveness.

The assassin was dumbfounded when he saw that three more kings suddenly appeared in Wang Shuo's tent, bursting the tent.

Damn it, the script is wrong!

Wang Shuo immediately launched a fierce attack on the assassin.

With the assistance of Ice Phoenix Emperor and Maris, the unlucky assassin was quickly killed.

Wang Shuo flew into the air and saw the assassins killing people.

There was a sudden burst of fire in my heart.

The top management of the Vana Empire also responded very quickly.

The assassins achieved little results.

Wang Shuo unceremoniously used his ultimate move, facing Li Yijun, the "Mighty Heavenly Dragon" move.

If the assassins are not eliminated as soon as possible, Wang Shuo is also worried that something will happen.

Li Yijun's dead soul appeared. This powerful move could not be intercepted at first sight.

But the golden dragon was like a living creature, and no matter how hard he tried to avoid it, he couldn't get rid of it.

There was no way to avoid it, so he could only use all his strength to stop it.
